card.name: Words just before a new clause begins
card.fires_on: Fires on the word that closes a short phrase in warning text, such as the end of a repeated section heading ("Toxicity"), "females" after "fertility in", or "case" in "in the case of". The next word starts a new statement.

modes.label: Heading repeated as "-ity"
modes.description: The ending of a toxicity heading that is repeated right before its paragraph begins.
modes.example: Renal Toxicity and Hyperkalemia Renal Toxic<<ity>> Long-term administration of NSAIDs has resulted

modes.label: Fertility in females
modes.description: The word "females" ending a statement about suppressed fertility.
modes.example: and may cause suppression of fertility in<< females>>. Advise patients that fertility may be

modes.label: In the case of
modes.description: The word "case" in "in the case of", introducing an exception.
modes.example: caution should be exercised, and in the<< case>> of recurrence, medication should be discontinued.

card.writes: No clear meaning; it weakly pushes toward a few odd word pieces and away from some Chinese phrases.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a short phrase in a warning ends and a new point is about to start.
